rounds.q: How deep is the ocean on average, in meters?
rounds.why: The deepest spot, Challenger Deep, is about 10,935 meters down.
rounds.fun: Challenger Deep is about 10,935 meters down, nearly 3 times the average depth!

rounds.q: Roughly what % of Earth's oxygen comes from the ocean?
rounds.why: One tiny ocean bacterium, Prochlorococcus, makes up to 20% of the biosphere's oxygen.
rounds.fun: Roughly half our oxygen comes from the ocean. Thank it for every other breath!

rounds.q: What % of the ocean fish stocks scientists track are overfished?
rounds.why: Still, about 77% of all fish caught comes from stocks fished sustainably.
rounds.src: FAO, State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture 2024 (2021 data)
rounds.fun: 38% of stocks are overfished, yet about 77% of the catch is sustainable. Go fish!

rounds.q: What % of the world's coral reefs got hot enough to bleach in 2023-2025?
rounds.why: Reefs cover under 1% of the ocean floor but support about 25% of sea life.
rounds.src: NOAA Coral Reef Watch; NOAA Fisheries
rounds.fun: Reefs cover under 1% of the sea floor but hold about 25% of sea life. Tiny town, big crowd!

rounds.q: By weight, what % of the world's traded goods travel by ship?
rounds.why: By value it's a bit lower, but still over 70% of global trade goes by ship.
rounds.fun: About 80% of goods trade goes by sea. Your stuff might be a seasoned sailor!
